title: KYE Problem Detail (RFC 7807) — Canonical HTTP Error Response Envelope
description: CANONICAL: the single error-response envelope every KYE™ API surface (gateway-worker, pep-express, pages-functions, rules-gateway, estate-engine, admin Functions) returns on every non-2xx HTTP response, with Content-Type: application/problem+json. Extends RFC 7807 with KYE-specific members for trace correlation, decision provenance, reason codes, field-level validation feedback, retry guidance, support links, and category-grouping. Per §0 (Zero Competing Systems) + §41 (Error Horizons) + §43 (Machine-Readable by Default), the per-error-code → http_status / category / sdk_throw_class / retry_class binding lives in internal; the reason_code enum (a.k.a. error code) lives in internal (extended with http_status + category columns). Wave-ErrorsEnvelope (2026-05-30) consolidated four divergent runtime shapes — `{error, detail}` (gateway-worker), `{error: {code, reason}}` (pep-express), `{error, message}` (estate-engine), `{ok: false, error}` (pages-functions / admin Functions) — into this envelope and added field_errors / category / occurred_at / request_id / support_url / trace_id for SDK ergonomics.

type.description: URI that identifies the problem type. KYE codes use https://kye.dev/errors/{reason_code}.

title.description: Human-readable summary of the problem type.

status.description: HTTP status code matching the response.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence.

instance.description: URI / path of the resource instance this error occurred on.

reason_code.description: Machine-readable, vocabulary-pinned reason code. See public/vocabulary/decision-codes.md.

correlation_id.description: KYE correlation URN tying this error to its trace.

policy_decision_id.description: KYE policy-decision URN, when this error is the result of a denied authorize call.

audit_event_id.description: KYE audit-event URN written for this error.

supported_versions.description: Set on 406 with reason_code=version_not_acceptable. Lists negotiable versions.

retry_after_seconds.description: Set on 429 / 503. Mirrors the Retry-After header.

obligations_violated.description: When the error is an obligation enforcement failure, the obligation IDs that failed.

category.description: Wave-ErrorsEnvelope: coarse-grained grouping used by SDKs to choose a throw class, by dashboards to colour-code, and by SLO scoring. MUST agree with the row in internal for this reason_code.

request_id.description: Wave-ErrorsEnvelope: server-assigned correlation ID for this single HTTP request. Mirrors the `x-kye-request-id` response header. Distinct from `correlation_id` (which scopes a multi-request trace).

occurred_at.description: Wave-ErrorsEnvelope: ISO-8601 UTC instant when the server produced the error. Helps SDK retry/backoff math and correlates with §35 Streaming Logs.

trace_id.description: Wave-ErrorsEnvelope: W3C trace-context trace_id (32 lowercase hex) for distributed-trace correlation across Cloudflare → Workers → D1 / R2 / Vectorize spans.

support_url.description: Wave-ErrorsEnvelope: deep-link to the human-readable runbook / status page for this error class. Typically https://kyeprotocol.com/errors/{reason_code} (mirrors the `type` URI but routes to docs rather than the machine-readable problem-type doc).

field_errors.description: Wave-ErrorsEnvelope: present on category='validation' responses (HTTP 400/422). One entry per offending input field; gives the SDK a path-keyed error map for form rendering.

field.description: JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) or dotted-path to the offending field. Example: '/applicant/email' or 'applicant.email'.

code.description: Machine-readable validation reason. SHOULD be a term in the errors dictionary if cross-handler; MAY be handler-local.

message.description: Human-readable message for the offending field. Safe to render in a form.
